rule: C functions bare; ObjC methods `Class#selector` with keyword colons (`doX:withY:`); `[obj m]` → `obj.m`. | `self.m()` / `this.m()` / a bare call to a member of the enclosing type → `Type#m`. If `m` is defined only on a superclass that is in the scan, the callee is `Superclass#m`. | **medium**: the callee is named statically (Type.m(), module.f(), an import, `self.m()` inherited from a base outside the scan, an external library type) but is not defined in the scan.
notes: call_type convention used throughout this corpus: a callee that is a member of a type (`T#m`) or a receiver-qualified guess (`recv.m`, `.m`) is `method`; a C function (bare name) is `direct`. A category adds methods to the class it names; the ID form is `Class#selector`, and the category name (Extras, Shout) is not a class, so category methods are `Widget#highlight` and `NSString#shout` (the definition is scanned → high when called on a receiver typed NSString). Inside the NSString category, `[self uppercaseString]` is defined on NSString outside the scan → `NSString#uppercaseString` medium.
